narrative.details:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
narrative.objectives: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 8, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Infiltrating the Cult
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

quests.name: Falaath Village
quests.objectiveText: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

quests.name: Among the Faithful
quests.objectiveText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

quests.name: Havoc in the Highlands
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

quests.name: To Valanaar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
